preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of roads is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities, each numbered between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of days k matches the number of lists in the repaired_days output.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= d <= n - 1 for d in [len(roads_per_day) for roads_per_day in repaired_days])
postconditions.description: Each day's list of roads contains between 1 and n - 1 roads.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= road_number <= n - 1 for roads_per_day in repaired_days for road_number in roads_per_day)
postconditions.description: Each road number in the output is between 1 and n - 1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(road_number in range(1, n) for roads_per_day in repaired_days for road_number in roads_per_day)
postconditions.description: Each road number in the output corresponds to a road in the input.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(roads_per_day)) == len(roads_per_day) for roads_per_day in repaired_days)
postconditions.description: Each day's list of roads contains no duplicate road numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(road_number in set(road_numbers) for road_number in range(1, n) for road_numbers in repaired_days)
postconditions.description: All roads are repaired exactly once.
